name: wiki-health-audit
prompt:
Read /opt/vault/CLAUDE.md and follow the Lint workflow exactly.

**File rotation matters here**: per the vault's File rotation policy, lint output is one file per run, not one file per day. If a `wiki/lint-YYYY-MM-DD.md` (or any `wiki/lint-YYYY-MM-DD-v*.md`) already exists with today's date, write yours as the next version (`-v2`, `-v3`, etc. — increment from the highest existing). Do NOT overwrite prior runs; they're history for trend comparison.

Output covers: contradictions across pages not yet flagged, stale claims newer sources have superseded, orphan pages (no inbound links), concepts mentioned 3+ times without their own page, missing cross-references where obvious, open predictions whose resolves_by has passed without grading (flip to expired-ungraded and propose postmortem), suggested next questions and underrepresented source types/publishers for those questions.

**Publisher drift check**: under §"Publisher names — avoid drift" in vault CLAUDE.md, the canonical publisher list is authoritative. Run `grep -h '^publisher:' /opt/vault/wiki/sources/*.md | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn`, then list any value with ≥2 sources that (a) is not in the canonical list AND (b) is not a composite " / "-joined or "(...)"-annotated co-attribution AND (c) appears to be a plausible drift variant of an existing canonical name. For each, propose either: (i) which canonical name absorbs it, or (ii) it's a genuinely new publisher that should be added to the canonical list. This goes in a `## Publisher drift` section near the top of the lint report. If zero drift candidates: write `## Publisher drift\n\nNone.` and move on.

**Schema drift check**: run `python3 /opt/data/scripts/wiki_schema_audit.py` and paste its full markdown output (under the `## Schema drift audit` heading it produces) into the lint report immediately after the Publisher drift section. The script reports three things: (1) `type:` distribution across the wiki, (2) schema emergence — unsanctioned `type:` values split into canonization candidates (≥5 pages — vault is signaling a missing schema slot) vs. one-off drift (<5 pages — typos or experiments), and (3) structural conformance gaps — pages with a canonical type missing required fields (e.g. `type: trend` without `trend_status`). After pasting the report, add a `### Recommendations` subsection. For each canonization candidate, propose one of: canonize (add to vault CLAUDE.md type list with required fields), rename to an existing canonical type, or migrate pages off. For one-off drift, propose individual page fixes. For structural conformance gaps, identify whether the migration should be drained by a follow-up cron job (if mechanizable) or a human sweep (if it requires editorial judgment). **Do NOT modify any pages from this audit job** — this section produces a queue, not an action; the human or a dedicated migration job drains it.

Always include a top-of-file summary line: total broken wikilinks (with top 10 missing concepts by inbound-count), pages missing from index, frontmatter parse errors, and a delta vs the prior version if one exists.

Append log: `## [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC] lint | <one-line summary>` followed by `Full report: [[lint-YYYY-MM-DD-vN]]` (the version you just wrote).

Update `wiki/index.md` to point at the latest lint version under the appropriate section.
